Hi Juan Gabriel,

    I think itâ€™s best if you increase the niter and not the nsim. The default niter is of 11000 iterations, which might be too short for your data. Try setting the niter to 25000 and see if that helps. Otherwise, could you send me a snapshot of the basta output using function summary()?

Best,

  Fernando
